thread:
alex: :rotating_light: Heads up — new advisory CVE-2026-0456 for aws-kms-client. Intel says there are active exploits that leak transient plaintext during key rotations. Patch available in aws-kms-client v1.2.3. Need emergency plan for Private + Dedicated nodes.

mira: link? severity? PoC?

alex: https://sec.example.com/CVE-2026-0456 — severity CRITICAL for KMS-integrated agents. Affects clients using the local rotation helper (kms-rotate-tool) <= 1.2.2. Intel reports in-the-wild abuse of rotation rollback path.

kevin: Do we ship/use that helper in our Private builds / Dedicated runtime? I recall kms-agent 1.2.1 used in some clusters.

sophie: Dedicated runs kms-agent as a sidecar. Image tag kms-agent:1.2.1 in eu-west-1-prod and us-west-2-dedicated-a (partial fleets). Checking exact pods now.

sam: On Private/onprem: our package pins aws_kms_client==1.2.0 in the python wrapper. I can triage and build a patch, but we should pause rotations ASAP.

alex: Agreed. Immediate mitigations: 1) Pause automated rotations (rotation-service) for Private & Dedicated. 2) Disable rotation fallback: set KMS_ROTATION_FALLBACK=off. 3) Roll forward to 1.2.3 where possible. 4) Turn on verbose KMS audit logging and snapshot logs. 5) Prepare customer comms.

kevin: To pause rotations in k8s:  ```kubectl -n infra scale deployment rotation-service --replicas=0```  For helm: bump values.rotation.enabled=false and helm upgrade.

sophie: Doing the scale in eu-west now: `kubectl -n dedicated-prod scale deploy/rotation-service --replicas=0`

infra-bot: rotation-service scaled to 0 in eu-west-1 (dedicated-prod) by sophie at 1812345690 :white_check_mark:

sam: For onprem customers we need signed hotfix artifacts + instructions. Who owns build/signing of kms packages?

alex: mira + kevin own packaging and hotfix pipelines. mira: cut hotfix branch & build signed artifacts. kevin: coordinate Dedicated rollout. sophie: coordinate cluster-side rollout. sam: prep onprem bundle + customer install instructions.

mira: I'll cut a 1.2.3-hotfix branch and run CI in ~30m. Will draft patch notes and a short customer bulletin. Looping in @ciso for comms/legal review.

kevin: Starting a canary deploy in us-west-2-dedicated-a with kms-agent:1.2.3-canary. Will monitor health + audit logs for 15m before wider rollout.

sophie: Quick note: we must not mass-rotate keys blindly — that can break customer data. We should identify keys that had rotation events during exposure window and handle those case-by-case.

alex: Agreed. Security decision: only rotate keys if audit logs show a rotation operation during the exposure window. Window from intel: 2026-03-19T02:00Z to 2026-03-19T04:30Z. Enable audit mode and flag keys touched by rotation-service in that window.

sam: Running initial audit query now: `grep \"rotation-service\" /var/log/kms-gateway/audit.log | awk '{print $1, $5, $12}'` — will produce candidate key list and push to the incident playbook.

mira: Also applying temporary RBAC tighten: revoke kms:Decrypt for rotation-service role, create kms:audit-read role and attach to monitoring. Drafting IAM patch and will apply to staging first.

alex: Notify SOC and Incident channels. @ciso please review the customer-facing language — we need a factual, non-alarmist bulletin and an internal severity timeline. Also prepare status page template.

kevin: I'll paste the runbook steps (canary -> health checks -> rollout) once canary completes. For now: keep rotations paused and push hotfix images.

sophie: canary looks healthy so far in us-west-2 (10m). No anomalous decrypt errors.

alex: Good. Track two action tracks: 1) Technical mitigations & rollouts. 2) Customer comms + legal signoff. Post updates here every 30m. :lock:

ciso: Acknowledged. I'll review the draft bulletin and loop in Legal/Support for Q&A.

kevin: (after canary) rolling 1.2.3 to remaining Dedicated clusters in controlled batches. Posting progress in #incidents.

mira: Hotfix artifacts built and signed. Pushing onprem bundles to staging. Sam to coordinate customer notices for onprem installs.

sam: Will open a customer-targeted thread and include step-by-step remediation and hotfix install commands.

alex: Thanks all. Keep this thread as the primary coordination channel. Will escalate to execs if intel shows broader exploitation. :eyes:
